name: voice-coach
description: Gives Claude ears: local pitch, pronunciation and public-speaking analysis so Claude can coach your voice.
long_description: Records from your microphone and analyzes audio locally: pitch accuracy against equal temperament, a key or a MIDI melody; phoneme-level English pronunciation; and pace, pauses, filler words, monotony and volume of a speech. Tools return compact measurements; Claude turns them into coaching. Audio never leaves your computer. The first launch installs the Python dependencies with uv and later downloads the speech (~480 MB) and phoneme (~1.3 GB) models on first use.

tools.name: record_audio
tools.description: Record from the microphone to a 16 kHz mono WAV.

tools.name: analyze_pitch
tools.description: Pitch accuracy against equal temperament, a key or a MIDI melody.

tools.name: speech_metrics
tools.description: Pace, pauses, filler words, pitch monotony and volume variation.

tools.description: Append a session to the progress log.
